body:
Can confirm on Linux as well with `v.4.6.1.stable` and `v4.7.dev3`.

Will try to get a stack trace of this error to better understand what causes it.

Backtrace (from commit 4a919adccf8e398aceca75399c539078c54fe97f):
```
#0  ProgressDialog::_reparent_and_show (this=0x555566887310) at editor/gui/progress_dialog.cpp:184
#1  0x000055555b1ceb74 in ProgressDialog::_popup (this=0x555566887310) at editor/gui/progress_dialog.cpp:175
#2  0x000055555b1cf13b in ProgressDialog::add_task (this=0x555566887310, p_task=..., p_label=..., p_steps=5, p_can_cancel=false) at editor/gui/progress_dialog.cpp:226
#3  0x000055555acb25ff in EditorNode::progress_add_task (p_task=..., p_label=..., p_steps=5, p_can_cancel=false) at editor/editor_node.cpp:5923
#4  0x000055555acb24bb in EditorProgress::EditorProgress (this=0x7fffffffc538, p_task=..., p_label=..., p_amount=5, p_can_cancel=false, p_force_background=false) at editor/editor_node.cpp:229
#5  0x000055555b1331fa in EditorFileSystem::_first_scan_filesystem (this=0x555565e48510) at editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:318
#6  0x000055555b13cfa8 in EditorFileSystem::scan (this=0x555565e48510) at editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:1087
#7  0x000055555acb9cb9 in EditorNode::_notification (this=0x555565dbe590, p_what=17) at editor/editor_node.cpp:913
#8  0x000055555ad1024d in EditorNode::_notification_forwardv (this=0x555565dbe590, p_notification=17) at editor/editor_node.h:121
#9  0x000055555ebb9520 in Object::_notification_forward (this=0x555565dbe590, p_notification=17) at core/object/object.cpp:896
#10 0x0000555558a178ae in Object::notification (this=0x555565dbe590, p_notification=17, p_reversed=false) at ./core/object/object.h:720
#11 0x000055555c19e64b in SceneTree::_process_group (this=0x555565d27f20, p_group=0x555565d28140, p_physics=false) at scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:1225
#12 0x000055555c19b9b6 in SceneTree::_process (this=0x555565d27f20, p_physics=false) at scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:1302
#13 0x000055555c19c601 in SceneTree::process (this=0x555565d27f20, p_time=0.13333333333333375) at scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:715
#14 0x0000555558b178c3 in Main::iteration () at main/main.cpp:5036
#15 0x0000555558a1f918 in OS_LinuxBSD::run (this=0x7fffffffd4f0) at platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp:1006
#16 0x0000555558a36730 in main (argc=6, argv=0x7fffffffdb48) at platform/linuxbsd/godot_linuxbsd.cpp:122
```
When backtracking without the `--script` argument, it hits the exact same frames and lines. This suggests that somewhere in the code, when launching from the `--script` argument, no window is set in time before this runs:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4a919adccf8e398aceca75399c539078c54fe97f/editor/gui/progress_dialog.cpp#L181-L184
The "--editor" flag tries to create a second main loop. Just add a `script.is_empty()` and it'll work fine. Sorry to the maintainers for my naive understanding of github. I'll create another PR.
